decision: For maximum application control, use OpenAI Agents SDK: your application owns deployment, tools, state storage, approvals, and runtime integration; SDK runs the loop. For managed sessions/orchestration/compaction/recovery, OpenAI Agents API manages that harness, while you supply tools and select environment/compute. Responses API is the lower-level request/tool-call interface and does not by itself promise durable sessions or a managed autonomous harness. Claude Agent SDK runs Claude Code's loop/tools/context/permissions/sessions in an app-operated process; app supplies key and operates process. Choose Agents SDK or Claude Agent SDK for control; Agents API for provider-managed harness; choose compute/filesystem based on explicit environment ownership.
caveats: Docs are not runtime proof. A distribution subset lacks a locally verified Anthropic Managed Agents reference; do not infer that product's behavior or equate the four choices beyond documented mechanics.

evidence.quote: The SDK runs the agent loop and invokes the configured tools.
The Agent SDK provides the agent loop, built-in tools, context management, permissions, and session management.
